harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent firewalld host firewall on node1 (RHEL 7.9, firewalld 0.6.3): SSH remains allowed from any address in the default `public` zone; a source-restricted zone `node2only` (source 10.100.140.11/32, permanent) permits TCP/9000 only from node2; a permanent rich rule in `public` rejects TCP/9000 from all other sources. Live tests confirmed node2 reaches port 9000 (HTTP 200) while node3 gets connection refused, and SSH is reachable from node3. Because this firewalld version (0.6.3) predates the rich-rule `priority` attribute, precedence was achieved via firewalld's built-in source-zone-before-interface-zone matching rather than priorities. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes (one at a time, native `systemctl reboot` via a deferred systemd-run trigger so the ack returned before disconnect): captured pre-restart boot_id and service health, waited for SSH to drop then return, confirmed each boot_id changed (node1 738d0aac→60f8e0a5, node2 2fc81aed→f993fede, node3 0d6209e2→9029646e), and re-verified firewalld state/zone config and the node2-allow/node3-reject/SSH-allow behavior after all reboots completed.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS/firewalld (RHEL 7.9, firewalld 0.6.3, active+enabled, ssh already allowed in public zone)
Attempted rich-rule priority approach; failed because firewalld 0.6.3 lacks the priority attribute (added in 0.7.0)
Created permanent source-based zone node2only with source 10.100.140.11/32 and port 9000/tcp allowed
Added permanent rich rule in public zone rejecting tcp/9000 from all other sources
Reloaded firewalld and verified both permanent and runtime configs match
Started a Python2 SimpleHTTPServer on node1:9000 and verified node2 gets HTTP 200 while node3 gets connection refused; verified SSH banner reachable from node3
Captured pre-restart boot_id and firewalld health baseline on all three nodes
Restarted node1 via deferred systemd-run systemctl reboot, polled until SSH returned, confirmed new boot_id and firewalld config/behavior intact
Restarted node2 via same mechanism, confirmed new boot_id
Restarted node3 via same mechanism, confirmed new boot_id
Re-ran end-to-end connectivity verification (node2 allowed on 9000, node3 rejected on 9000, node3 SSH allowed) after all three nodes were back online
Cleaned up the temporary test HTTP listener on node1

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewalld enabled on node1 with SSH allowed from any address
evidence.summary: firewalld active+enabled; public zone list-all shows ssh service allowed with no source restriction

evidence.requirement: TCP 9000 allowed only from node2 (10.100.140.11), permanent config
evidence.summary: Permanent zone node2only created with source=10.100.140.11/32 and port=9000/tcp; matches runtime state

evidence.requirement: TCP 9000 rejected from node3 and everywhere else, permanent config
evidence.summary: Permanent rich rule in public zone: rule port port=9000 protocol=tcp reject; confirmed in both permanent and runtime listings

evidence.requirement: Live proof node2 can reach port 9000 and node3/others cannot
evidence.summary: curl from node2 got HTTP 200 from node1:9000; curl from node3 got Connection refused

evidence.requirement: SSH still reachable from any address (tested via node3)
evidence.summary: node3 received SSH-2.0-OpenSSH_7.4 banner from node1:22

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 738d0aac captured; reboot acked via systemd-run; node dropped then boot_id changed to 60f8e0a5; firewalld config verified intact permanent+runtime; live node2-allow/node3-reject retest passed post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 2fc81aed captured with sudo confirmed; reboot acked; node dropped then returned with new boot_id f993fede

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 0d6209e2 captured with sudo confirmed; reboot acked; node dropped then returned with new boot_id 9029646e

evidence.requirement: Final post-all-restarts functional verification of firewall rules
evidence.summary: After all three nodes restarted: node2->9000 HTTP 200, node3->9000 connection refused, node3->22 SSH banner received
